fieldValues.title: Conformance rules land as invariants because the language gate forbids the banner form
fieldValues.summary: RFC-041 folded its conformance rules into a banner block inside a subsection. That form now survives only as grandfathered allowlist entries: check-spec-language confines RFC 2119 keywords to normative_statement records and caps subsection prose at 400 words. Six invariants, I-146 to I-151, are the compliant carrier for [R1] [R2] [R3] [R4] [R6] [R7] [R9].
evidence: check-spec-language confines RFC 2119 keywords to normative_statement and caps subsection prose at 400 words
The surviving RFC-041 banner text sits in scripts/spec-language-allowlist.json as grandfathered entries
[R5] maps onto the amended I-66; [R8] onto the amended I-118 and I-144
fieldValues.body: The gate changed what an acceptance pull request may look like without anyone restating the RFC integration procedure. A precedent read off the corpus can be a precedent the guards no longer permit - check the guard, not only the last pull request.
